Aviance Capital Partners Stake in Coca (KO) Lowered by $459,713; General American Investors Company Increases Holding in Apple (AAPL)
June 26, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
General American Investors Company Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 9.62% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. General American Investors Company Inc bought 10,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 114,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $19.13 million, up from 104,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. General American Investors Company Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $909.78B market cap company. The stock increased 1.61% or $2.9269 during the last trading session, reaching $185.0969. About 11.51 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Aviance Capital Partners Llc decreased its stake in Coca (KO) by 30% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aviance Capital Partners Llc sold 10,691 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.70% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,949 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.08M, down from 35,640 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aviance Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Coca for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $186.02B market cap company.
